props.author: Crypto_Chase
props.text:
Copy trading era cooling — market difficulty escalating. The "PvE environment" (easy-money phase) from past week/two likely peaked as mindshare maxes out. Runners have already 3x-100x; new entrants at disadvantage. Requires own thesis + early timing for next 100x+.

I'd expect the difficulty level to increase from here moving forward. With that said, I have no doubt there's a runner, if not 3~ big runners, to find over the next month.
